title: Perfect Pi Runtime Phase Contract
description: Machine-readable contract governing phase boundaries, context compaction gates, and lifecycle transitions across Matt Pocock skills.

grill-me.rationale: Grilling requires continuous reasoning across stress-testing; lossy summarization causes the model to lose architectural nuance.

grill-with-docs.rationale: Documentation grilling requires keeping primary citations and domain terminology intact.

to-spec.rationale: Once SPEC.md is written and verified, chat rationale is externalized into the durable artifact.
to-spec.customInstructions: Preserve the architectural decisions, constraints, and scope boundaries established in SPEC.md. Discard exploratory brainstorming.

to-tickets.rationale: Ticket graph is fully persisted under .scratch/<feature>/issues/; previous conversational history is now disposable.

implement-spec.rationale: Ticket graph execution uses isolated subagents per ticket; coordinator context must remain lean.

implement.rationale: Each ticket should execute in a clean context rehydrated strictly from ticket + spec + repo commit.

tdd.rationale: Failing test output and diagnostic traces must remain intact until refactor phase completes.

diagnosing-bugs.rationale: Hypotheses, reproduction traces, and negative evidence are primary sources until root cause is isolated.

code-review.rationale: Review passes execute via subagents or complete in one continuous evaluation; reports are durable artifacts.

gateA_durability.name: Durability Gate
gateA_durability.description: Phase deliverables must be committed or written to disk before compaction.

gateB_semanticDependency.name: Semantic Dependency Gate
gateB_semanticDependency.description: If downstream work requires primary source reasoning (e.g. grilling -> implementation without spec), compaction is withheld.

gateC_economic.name: Economic Gate
gateC_economic.description: ExpectedTokensSaved > CacheRewriteCost, with a minimum saving threshold of 2,000 tokens.
